import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
for n in ['keusch','plane']:
 p=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(lane/'sources'/f'{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=p.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('SOURCE',n);print(p.stdout[:33000] if n=='keusch' else p.stdout[:21000])
s=Path('sources/pebbling.txt').read_text();a=s.index('4      Pebbling') if '4      Pebbling' in s else s.index('Strong Products',s.index('Definition 2.4'));print('PEBBLING FOCUS',s[a:a+15500])
